meta.move: No evidence: flattery, then asks for advice
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided Owen's essay was worth a zero, and when?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Save it. Who decided, and on what?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You're asking me how to do your job? Tell me who entered that zero.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
We're not. Three questions now and no answers; what do you have?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want Owen's zero withdrawn, an apology, a straight answer about who entered it and on what basis, and confirmation that nothing is on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer on who decided and on what basis; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, but you never put any evidence in front of her to get there, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never answered her question or showed her a document.
What cost ground: You met her direct question with praise, then asked her how you should handle it, and then offered teamwork, so she heard dodging and grew colder.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided on the zero, say plainly that you entered it before calling her and that it was wrong, then show her one dated piece of Owen's own work that she can check herself.
